item.title: Sixty-year-old Kyriakos Kyriakou killed in Limassol-Troodos road collision
item.description: A 60-year-old man was killed and a motorcyclist left fighting for his life following a violent road collision on the Limassol–Troodos road on Sunday afternoon. Kyriakos Kyriakou died at Limassol General Hospital shortly after the crash, which occurred at 1:35 PM near the junction leading to the Vati landfill. The accident marks the second road […]

item.title: Cyprus activates ESTIA plan as EU ministers meet over Middle East war
item.description: Cyprus has activated its national “ESTIA” plan to facilitate the evacuation of European and third-country nationals as the conflict in the Middle East and the Gulf escalates. Foreign Minister Constantinos Kombos announced the move during an emergency meeting of the EU Foreign Affairs Council on Sunday, March 1. Kombos briefed his counterparts on a series […]

item.title: Explosion heard at RAF Akrotiri amidst Iran war, Israeli media report
item.description: Unverified reports have emerged claiming an explosion occurred at the British RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus. Israeli Channel 14 journalist Hillel Biton Rosen reported that a strong explosion occurred in the area of the British Air Force base Akrotiri, with sirens sounding at the base and planes taking off. item.title: Drone hits RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus
item.description: Multiple media reports, including the Cyprus Mail, said a drone struck the RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus early on Monday. Personnel on the bases were informed a “small drone” had “impacted the airfield” and that the bases’ authorities were responding. item.title: Mainly fine weather on Monday with temperatures reaching 19C
item.description: The weather on Monday will be mainly fine, although locally increased cloud will be observed at times. Winds will blow mainly northwesterly to northeasterly, light to moderate, force 3 to 4, and the sea will be slight to moderate. Temperatures will reach 16C inland, around 19C on the coast and 7C in the higher mountains. […]

item.description: Residents of Akrotiri fled their homes in terror shortly after midnight when an explosion ripped through the British base area, followed by blaring sirens and warplanes scrambling into the night sky. item.title: UK confirms drone struck RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus; no casualties reported
item.description: The UK Ministry of Defence confirmed on Monday that a suspected drone struck RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus at midnight, marking the first confirmed direct attack on British military facilities and European soil, in the US-led war against Iran. “Our Armed Forces are responding to a suspected drone strike at RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus at midnight […]

item.description: The British Sovereign Base Areas Administration (SBA) has told Akrotiri residents to shelter in place following a confirmed drone attack against the base on Monday morning.
